description: A fast, ESLint-compatible JavaScript and TypeScript parser.

scripts.bench:chart: npm run build && node benchmarks/benchmark.js --json=benchmarks/results.json && node benchmarks/chart.js benchmarks/results.json benchmarks/results.svg
